scope: Twenty healthy participants; three complete trials linked. Forecasts assess device/airway signal continuity under rapid occlusion, not separately identified lung compliance or clinical accuracy.
calibration: Source fixed ADC-to-cmH2O conversion; no target-participant fitted coefficients. All history at or before forecast origin.
timing: At each fixed1s origin predict native gauge pressure0.20s later using only present/past pressure and differential-pressure signals.
selection: Whole-group OOF primary metric; choose simplest parameter-count model within1% of minimum among baselines and attempts. At least5 substantive adaptive attempts, followed by two consecutive no>1% prediction gains and no unresolved promising mechanistic/robustness hypothesis.
group_weighting: Each independent group equal; rows within group equal.
uncertainty: Individual-group errors and paired group deltas; small-group evidence not population confidence. No dependent-row bootstrap.
exposure: Public source-aware data. Only schemas, metadata and published interpretations inspected before this freeze; case76 one zero-spike first-prefix row seen and its date assigned development. Internal confirmation outcomes not printed or scored before model/stopping freeze.
baseline_families: simple, established domain and constrained flexible predictor with identical input budget
confirmation_rule: Separate confirm.py; verifies frozen scripts, source/splits, attempt states and selected identity; no fitting.
